metadata.scenario: An interested customer wants to know more about available mental health programs. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Susan Garcia. I was referred by my father’s pulmonologist. Hi Susan, it’s nice to meet you. What can we assist you with? I’m looking for information on respiratory care for my father. He has COPD and needs assistance with breathing treatments. Absolutely, we can help with that. Are you looking for skilled nursing care? Yes, that would be great. What does that involve? Skilled Nursing Care includes medication management, health monitoring, and assistance with breathing treatments. How often would a nurse visit? Typically, visits are scheduled for 1 to 2 hours, depending on your father's needs. And what’s the cost for that service? The price ranges from $95 to $125 per visit. Sounds reasonable. Would the nurse also help with any other conditions? Yes, our nurses are skilled in chronic disease management, which may benefit your father. That’s good to know. What if he needs ongoing support? We can set up ongoing care plans based on his needs and schedule regular visits. That would be ideal. Can I also get information on any mental health support? We don’t specifically offer mental health programs, but we can assist with companionship care. I see. Would that include someone to talk to him? Yes, our Companion Care service includes social interaction and support. What’s the pricing for companion care? Companion Care is priced between $25 to $30 per hour. That could be useful. Can I schedule a consultation? Absolutely, I can have our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, assist you with that. Great! What information do you need from me? Just your father's details and preferred times for a consultation. His name is Antonio Garcia, and I’m available this week after 3 PM. Perfect, I’ll pass this to Lisa, and she’ll call you to confirm the appointment. Thank you! Is there anything else I should know? Just that we’re here for any questions you may have along the way. That’s reassuring. I appreciate your help! You’re welcome, Susan! We look forward to assisting you. Thank you, have a great day! You too, take care!
